title: CEFR Goal Burn-Up Across Apps
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:sync goal_level=* progress_points=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(progress_points) as metric by _time goal_level
| sort 0 _time goal_level
description: Trends monthly progress points by CEFR goal for cross-app CEFR progress.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether cross-app CEFR progress are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `goal_level` on `language:sync` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly progress points.
visualization: Line chart of monthly progress points by CEFR goal.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how progress points changes month by month for each CEFR goal so you can see whether cross-app CEFR progress are heading the right way.
